title: Langur spa day (grooming follows rank)
caption:
Who grooms whom is never random.

In a langur troop, grooming tracks the pecking order, so watching who does the picking tells you who's in charge. Next time you see langurs on a temple wall or a forest road, watch who's working and who's relaxing.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Semnopithecus entellus).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
